description: Compare 2 or 3 products side by side for one task, from our test drives: send their slugs (from search_tools), names or domains, and the task in a few plain words. For each: driven or only listed, agent level (0-5), how far our agent got at each step and where it stopped, what it did on the task, how to connect (MCP, API, CLI), the date and its page; a name we don't cover comes back in not_covered. Read-only, no key needed.

task.description: The task in plain words, e.g. 'send a transactional email': adds each product's closest task and what our agent did there

tools.description: 2 or 3 products: each a slug from search_tools (e.g. 'resend'), a name or a domain

name: compare_tools
title: Compare products for a task
